title: Flow Fest Sim Earth arrival network
coordinateConvention: North-up local metres in the checked EPSG:26916 terrain frame; +x east and +z south.

sourceAuthority.operationalTopology: Austen's first-person corrections on 2026-08-25: check in at the lower gate; camp on the lower or upper tier but never Middle Earth; tent campers return through the lower gate and drive up to the west upper parking field; car camping stays in the open middle of the lower tier; Austen traced the direct upper-to-middle connector and the clear middle-to-lower connector over the registered orthophoto, and both pass beneath tree canopy without being treated as walkability-blocked by surface occlusion.

route.classification: route topology is Austen-observed; the two pedestrian connector centerlines are Austen-traced over the registered orthophoto; roads and all other exact coordinates remain interpreted proposals
route.physicalClearanceStatus: Gate 1 registers centerlines and measured elevation only. Orthophoto roads may run under lidar canopy, so no lidar layer is misrepresented as a physical drive-width or walk-width survey. Gate 2 must reserve the declared game-space widths; current physical and ADA clearance require field measurement.

stops.label: Lower gate check-in
stops.action: Check in at the gate beside lower-level parking and choose a camping type.
stops.firstFocus: A physical orientation board because measured surface occluders screen all three named tiers.
stops.understanding: This is the single arrival checkpoint, not the final vehicle destination.
stops.nextCue: The gate team directs the player to lower tent camping, upper tent camping, or lower car camping.

stops.label: Lower tent unload
stops.action: Drive to a representative lower-tier perimeter site and unload the tent and gear.
stops.firstFocus: Tent sites associated with the lower tier's perimeter rather than its open middle.
stops.understanding: The campsite is home, but an ordinary tent-camping vehicle cannot remain here.
stops.nextCue: Return to the car at the campsite, then follow traffic back to the lower gate.

stops.label: Return through lower gate
stops.action: Get back in the unloaded car and return through the lower gate.
stops.firstFocus: The same checkpoint now functioning as a traffic-control hinge.
stops.understanding: Parking is a separate trip after campsite selection.
stops.nextCue: Exit and follow the road uphill toward the west upper parking field.

stops.label: West upper parking
stops.action: Park in the field on the west side of the upper tier.
stops.firstFocus: A wide parking field and the remembered direction of camp.
stops.understanding: The vehicle relocation ritual is complete.
stops.nextCue: Walk back down to the campsite chosen at check-in.

stops.label: Lower tent home on foot
stops.pathClass: open-tier approaches composed with Austen-traced canopy-hidden upper-to-middle and middle-to-lower connectors
stops.action: Walk from upper parking back to the lower-tier campsite.
stops.firstFocus: Cross Middle Earth during arrival logistics, continue through the lower connector, then find the player's own tent as remembered home.
stops.understanding: Camping and parking occupy different tiers, and the player has already learned the path they will soon retrace.
stops.nextCue: After settling in, retrace the lower connector and return to Middle Earth as a participant.

stops.label: Proceed to Middle Earth
stops.action: Leave camp on foot and retrace the connector into the middle activity tier.
stops.firstFocus: The fire-circle, stage, and gathering tier now read as festival space rather than terrain crossed during parking logistics.
stops.understanding: The same ground changes meaning when the player returns as a participant.
stops.nextCue: People, workshops, sound, and changing light take over from arrival logistics.

stops.label: Useful task
stops.action: Complete one bounded volunteer task in the south-east interior of Middle Earth.
stops.firstFocus: People changing the same ordinary field the player entered after setting camp.
stops.understanding: The festival is made by participation.
stops.nextCue: Sound and a fictional lighting change lead toward the short uphill composition point.

stops.label: First-night choice
stops.action: Witness Middle Earth change after dusk, then choose to watch, practice, join, wander, or return to camp.
stops.firstFocus: The same visible activity tier now functioning as the fictional night heart; the reveal is temporal.
stops.understanding: The arrival ritual has become free festival life.
stops.nextCue: Route memory leads back to whichever camping branch the player chose.

segments.pathClass: open lower-tier approach plus Austen-traced connector beneath canopy

storyFrames.label: Check in low
storyFrames.action: Stop at the lower gate and complete check-in.
storyFrames.firstFocus: Gate crew, lower parking, and a physical tier map.
storyFrames.understanding: Every arrival begins on the lower level.
storyFrames.nextCue: Choose how and where to camp.

storyFrames.label: Choose camp
storyFrames.action: Choose lower tent, upper tent, or lower car camping.
storyFrames.firstFocus: Three choices with different vehicle consequences.
storyFrames.understanding: Middle Earth is never a campsite.
storyFrames.nextCue: Drive directly to the selected site.

storyFrames.label: Make home
storyFrames.action: Unload at a tent site or settle the car-camping site.
storyFrames.firstFocus: Lower tent sites use the outer part of the lower clearing; car camping uses an authored open-middle zone based on Austen's placement.
storyFrames.understanding: The selected branch becomes the return destination.
storyFrames.nextCue: Car campers stay; tent campers must relocate the car.

storyFrames.label: Return to the car
storyFrames.action: Tent campers get back in the unloaded car and return through the lower gate.
storyFrames.firstFocus: Traffic flow back toward the road.
storyFrames.understanding: Unloading and parking are separate phases.

storyFrames.label: Park west and high
storyFrames.action: Tent campers park in the west field on the upper tier.
storyFrames.firstFocus: A vehicle storage field far from some campsites.
storyFrames.understanding: Only the car-camping branch keeps the vehicle at home.
storyFrames.nextCue: Walk back to the selected campsite.

storyFrames.label: Return on foot
storyFrames.action: Walk from parking to the upper or lower tent campsite; car campers are already home.
storyFrames.firstFocus: The vertical relationship among parking and both camping tiers.
storyFrames.understanding: The player learns the site through the return walk, crossing Middle Earth on the lower-tent example.
storyFrames.nextCue: Settle, repack, and leave camp as a pedestrian.

storyFrames.label: Return to Middle Earth
storyFrames.action: Proceed from the chosen camp into the shared activity tier.
storyFrames.firstFocus: Fire circle, stage, people, and workshops rather than arrival logistics.
storyFrames.understanding: The player may have crossed this ground while walking home; returning as a participant ends the logistics tutorial.
storyFrames.nextCue: Follow people, sound, tasks, and classes.

storyFrames.label: First-night agency
storyFrames.action: After participating, choose what to do and remember the route back to the selected camp.
storyFrames.firstFocus: A temporal transformation of familiar Middle Earth.
storyFrames.understanding: The chosen campsite remains persistent across free play.
storyFrames.nextCue: Watch, practice, join, wander, or go home.

sightlines.label: Lower gate to lower camping
sightlines.purpose: The gate needs a tier map and volunteers; the lower camp is not directly readable.

sightlines.label: Lower gate to Middle Earth
sightlines.purpose: Arrival logistics remain distinct from festival activity space.

sightlines.label: Lower gate to upper camping
sightlines.purpose: Upper camping must be learned by road direction rather than direct view.

sightlines.label: West parking to upper camp
sightlines.purpose: The short upper-camp return is legible from parking.

sightlines.label: West parking to lower camp
sightlines.purpose: The lower-camp return requires remembered path cues.

sightlines.label: Lower camping to Middle Earth
sightlines.purpose: Middle Earth is a distinct destination reached through a connector.

sightlines.label: Upper camping to Middle Earth
sightlines.purpose: The upper and middle tiers remain spatially distinct.

sightlines.label: Dusk composition to Middle Earth
sightlines.purpose: A stable open-ground camera frames a temporal lighting reveal without depending on mast height.

evidenceClasses.measured: DTM elevation, lidar surface height, orthophoto registration, scale, and coordinate transforms.
evidenceClasses.austenObserved: First-person operational topology: camping eligibility, vehicle ritual, parking outcome, and the existence of the two canopy-hidden pedestrian connectors.
evidenceClasses.austenTraced: The two pedestrian connector centerlines Austen drew over the source-locked orthophoto on 2026-08-25.
evidenceClasses.interpreted: Tier-scale open ground, road centerlines traced from public imagery, and surface screens; field confirmation required.
evidenceClasses.invention: Festival placements, interactions, night transformation, and exact proposed coordinates beyond what public terrain or Austen's first-person account establishes.

claimSchemaMapping.austenTracedCenterlines: literal for the recorded user trace over the orthophoto; not a field survey

knownUnknowns: Austen's memory is authoritative for the arrival topology. His two connector traces are source-locked as orthophoto drawings, not centimetre-accurate field survey; all other exact Gate 1 placements remain registered proposals for comprehension review.
Lower tent camping is represented by a perimeter example point, not a claim that every perimeter location is usable.
The car-camping branch keeps the vehicle in the open middle of the lower level and skips the upper parking relocation.
Middle Earth is activity space and is excluded from every camping option.

Road centerlines are imagery-registered proposals. Austen drew the direct upper-to-middle and middle-to-lower walking centerlines over the registered orthophoto; the traces cross, but are not wholly covered by, lidar canopy. Footage or field observation may refine physical width, surface condition, drainage, and accessibility, but the recorded centerline curvature is no longer an agent guess.
No official festival map, trademark, schedule, attendee identity, or private campsite history is reproduced.
The eight-metre night-heart mast is fictional visual hierarchy only; no sightline check depends on its height.
